This movie got me thinking a lot, about how you will start a new job peacefully and decide to earn a truthful salary, despite all you are going through only to get tempted only few days after. Ty Hackett got a new job a guard for an armored truck on arrival, he meets the veterans on the job, who decide to teach him and assist him settle in well into the job, little did he know that they were up to something shady off their sleeves. Few days into settling in Mike Cochrane decides to inform him of their well thought of plan of robbing their own truck of $42m dollars and how that will settle them for life quietly and he can help his brother and pay off all their debts; Ty Hackett immediately refused and went home. Well, you will have to go check out this movie to find out if he joined them, if they succeeded and how things went down, the movie was packed with action and suspense from start to the vey end. The 88m crime, action movie was directed by Nimirod Antal, they featured actors like Matt Dillion, Jean Reno, Laurence Fishburne, Amaury Nolasco, Fred Ward, Milo Ventimiglia, Skeet Ulrich, Columbus Short and many more.
Honestly, I wasn’t so sure what to expect from this Saudi movie, but I was glad I made it to the very end, it was so cool, with display of wealth, riches and affluence, but it seemed a bit slow for me, as I am a fan of action movie lovers. Sultan was a very wealthy man, with a growing company, fleet of cars and a mansion, suddenly he made a wrong movie with a business investment and lost everything. He didn’t know how to relate this message to his wife and kids, but he had to. For them to survive they had to do some crazy things, the kids will have to give up somethings and sell their belongings to help their dad, one of the daughters will have to marry into another family to help save theirs. You will need to watch this movie to see the length they had to go to save their family, and how they all had to work together as a family. The 98m Saudi, middle Eastern, drama, comedies movie was directed by Ahmed El Gendy, they featured actors like Rashed Al Shamrani, Ida Alkusay, Adwa Bader, Ziyad Alamri, Ghada AlMulla, Fayez Bin Jurays, Fahad Albutairi etc.
If you enjoy South African comedy movies, then you might jump on this, for the romantic movie lovers, then this might be worth your while. In the movie, there were 3 single ladies, who were besties, they had all planned to remain in the same city and remain friends, but along the line one of them gets engaged and didn’t know how to inform her friends that she will be getting married in one month and relocating to Kenya after making a promise that they will all remain friends in the same city. You will need to go check out this movie to find out how they took the news, what they did when they heard and how this now affected their trip and their friendship. The 99m South African Romantic comedy films, comedies, romance, African movie was directed by Rethabile Ramaphakela, Katleho Ramaphakela, they featured popular South African actors like Fulu Modibedi, Tumi Morake, Buntu Petse, Keke Mphuthi, Yonda Thomas, Thabiso Rammusi, Motiatsi Mafashe, Harriet Manamela etc
